title: Quadratic system proof verification
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $L$ be a finite system of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Regard its solutions as Boolean words via the coordinatewise identification of Boolean values with $\mathbb{F}_2$. The associated proof system has positive rejection rate, is complete (every solution has a proof accepted with probability $1$), and satisfies the following soundness property: for every $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$, every Boolean word whose relative Hamming distance from every solution is greater than $\varepsilon$, and every Boolean proof, the rejection probability is strictly greater than $\varepsilon/100000$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite homogeneous quadratic system over $\mathbb{F}_2$
the input word has relative Hamming distance greater than $\varepsilon$ from every solution
the soundness conclusion holds for every Boolean proof
